records.objective: admit one bounded later-use goal after registration without widening its grant
records.mustNot: treat registration or queue availability as permission to execute arbitrary work

records.objective: resolve the minimum requested graph from canonical registered-checked records and explicit grants
records.mustNot: select unregistered, revoked, ungranted, or merely filesystem-present capability

records.objective: use only the admitted registered registry and queue capabilities and preserve grant refs in the immutable handoff
records.mustNot: execute functionality not present in the admitted graph

records.objective: verify observed registry resolution, immutable transport, local-trail evidence, and no authority widening
records.mustNot: repair the result while issuing a verdict

records.objective: emit exactly one future seed after checked later-use evidence
records.mustNot: allow the queue or registration layer to auto-consume that seed
